backtest.spread: Spreads, blend gap 3+ vs the opener, December-March 2023-26: CLV +1.32 pts, beat the close 68%, 55.7% ATS (922 plays, about 2 a day); gap 4+: +1.87, 74%, 59.8% (251 plays)
backtest.total: Totals, blend gap 5+: CLV +2.29 pts, beat the close 77%, 56.2% ATS (1,041 plays, about 3 a day); gap 6+: +2.90, 82%, 59.1% (465 plays)
backtest.nov: November: CLV about +0.5 and only half the plays beat the close, for every model (last season's ratings are a poor guide to new rosters)
backtest.caveat: The backtest measured CLV from Action Network's opener. In the CFB snapshots DK/FD/MGM's first spread matched that opener 20-30% of the time and already held about half the opener-to-close move, so live CLV may be smaller. The Openers tab tracks this for CBB.
